name: integer-range-operator-test-d441b901c6/integer-range-operators-v.bal
spec_references: Statements / Foreach: Currently only supports range, list, map, string and XML subtypes, and [iterable objects](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#section_5.8.2)
Subset restrictions / Object/class definitions: Supports `object-field-descriptor`, `method-decl`, `remote-method-decl` and `resource-method-decl` members
Module-level declarations / Class definition: Supports `object-field`, `method-defn` and `object-type-inclusion` members
reason: The range and iteration assertions are in scope, but several exercised range variables use object type descriptors containing `*object:Iterable;`. Object type inclusion is absent from the restricted supported object descriptor members; the explicit inclusion support belongs to class definitions. This essential construct makes the whole case a feature request.
unsupported_constructs: Object type inclusion (`*object:Iterable;`) inside anonymous object type descriptors
test_design_notes: Includes closed and half-open ranges, equal/reversed bounds, integer subtypes and singleton unions, hexadecimal bounds, and iterable/iterator isolatedness assertions.
